headline: MTN confirms early talks to buy Telkom; Telkom +15.9%, JSE -0.5%, gold near a one-year low
summary: MTN and Telkom said on Monday they are in early talks that could lead to an offer for all of Telkom's shares, planned mainly in cash with an MTN-share option, and Telkom was up 15.9% at R71.83 while the JSE All Share was at 111,800, 0.5% below Friday (Business Day and Reuters, 16 Nov 2026; LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 16 Nov 2026 13:59-14:15 SAST). The rand was at R16.94/$, about 1.1% weaker than Friday, ahead of October CPI on 18 November and the SARB decision on 19 November; Wall Street has not traded since Friday (LRC Market Dashboard, 13-16 Nov 2026). Gold was at $3,874.90 after Reuters reported a fall to its lowest since October 2025 on a strong dollar and bets on a December Fed hike, platinum was at $1,466.00 (-1.5%) and Brent at $95.06 (-0.8%) (Reuters via MarketScreener, 16 Nov 2026; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 13-16 Nov 2026).

items.title: MTN and Telkom confirm early takeover talks; Telkom up 15.9% at R71.83
items.summary: The companies said on Monday that, if the talks succeed, MTN would make an offer for all Telkom's shares, currently planned as cash with an option to take MTN shares instead. Terms are still being negotiated, there is no certainty of a deal, and both companies told shareholders to be cautious when trading their shares. Business Day puts Telkom's market value at R31.7bn and MTN's at R427.7bn; MTN walked away from an earlier approach in 2022. Reuters notes a deal would likely face regulatory scrutiny. On the JSE, Telkom was at R71.83 (+15.9%) and MTN at R230.86 (-1.6%) just before 14:00.
items.source: Business Day, 16 Nov 2026; Reuters via CNBC Africa, 16 Nov 2026 08:55 GMT; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance TKG.JO, MTN.JO), 16 Nov 2026 13:59 SAST
